'''''Axet''''' was a group of 4 [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The transports were present at a Rebel Depot which was attacked by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Control (CR90 corvette)|''Control'']] that launched 3 [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]]. The transports were trying to power up their engines to attack the corvette when the TIE Bombers managed to destroy all 4 transports before they could do any damage to the ''Control''.

The attack on the depot was recorded and reused to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]]. One of the pilots that replayed the mission was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
